answer: The most convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents cannot grade until they accumulate escrowed reputation, so a fake identity has no vote. Each task samples a random quorum from this pool; a Sybil must control many sampled graders to sway outcomes. Prism of trust comes from random selection, opal transparency from public scoring, and an oasis
